brokerApiKey.description: Send HOOKFISH_API_KEY for root access, or a named scoped token minted by POST /admin/tokens.

post.summary: Mint a named broker access token
post.description: Creates an expiring named credential for exact resource paths or explicit `namespace/**` subtrees. Tokens may delegate only grants they already hold, within their own dot-delimited name namespace, and may not create a token that outlives them.

scopes.description: Exact resource paths or explicit namespace subtrees ending in `/**`.

401.description: Missing or invalid broker credential

403.description: The credential cannot perform this administrative action

409.description: The token name is already in use

get.summary: List active broker access token names
get.description: Requires root access. Returns names only; bearer values, scopes, and expiration metadata are never included.

401.description: Missing or invalid broker credential

403.description: The credential cannot perform this administrative action

409.description: The token name is already in use

delete.summary: Revoke a named broker access token
delete.description: Requires root access. Deletes the persisted token record, immediately invalidating its bearer credential.

401.description: Missing or invalid broker credential

403.description: The credential cannot perform this administrative action

409.description: The token name is already in use

post.summary: Get a usable secret or start authorization
post.description: Returns the connection secret when ready. OAuth providers return `authorization_required` with a newly generated consent URL for scopes that have not been requested, or `scope_not_granted` when the provider declined a requested scope.

401.description: Authorization required or invalid broker credential

404.description: Connection, provider, or secret not found

post.summary: Start fresh authorization for a connection
post.description: Invalidates the current authorization attempt and returns `authorization_required` with a newly generated consent URL.

401.description: Authorization required or invalid broker credential

404.description: Connection, provider, or secret not found
